newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares close higher on secondaries buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares close higher on secondaries buying.

text.p: Jakarta shares closed higher on mixed trading on Thursday after active buying of many secondaries, brokers said.

The Jakarta Composite Index rose 3.79 points, or 0.54 percent, to 698.67 points after falling earlier to an intra-day low of 693.99 points. Gainers led losers by 84 to 41, with 62 counters unchanged. Turnover was 428.5 billion rupiah on a volume of 202.1 million shares.
"I don't expect too much excitement tomorrow because market sentiment remains relatively weak and there is no major news to spur foreign buying," a broker with European bank said.
Brokers said local players dominated Thursday's trading with their speculative buying of second and third line stocks while foreigners mostly stayed on the sideline.
They said the market shrugged off the news of the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
Thirdliner property firm Elang Realty was the most active stock with 19.4 million shares traded.
It ended almost 30 percent up, closing 200 rupiah higher at 875 rupiah, on speculation that a domestic conglomerate would buy a stake in the firm at a good price in a tender offer.
"I heard market speculation that businessmen Johannes Kotjo might buy a stake in the company through a tender offer," a local-broker said.
Secondaries garment firm Karwell, glue producer Intan Wijaya and Kurnia Kapuas were among the active stocks because of plans to split stocks or issue bonus shares, brokers said.
Shares in engineering firm Bukaka shed 14 percent to 1,675 rupiah in active trading after the World Bank clarified that it did not award project to companies but loans to governments.
Its shares soared on Wednesday because of a newspaper report of fresh World Bank funded projects.
Tin miner Tambang Timah rose 25 rupiah to 4,150 rupiah on a volume 4.5 million shares.
"A fair price for the stock is 4,125-4,150 rupiah and now it is moving to its normal level," a foreign broker said.
